tensura.velgrynd.summon_boss: A noble True Dragon descends... Insignificant mortal, how dare you awaken me?!
tensura.velgrynd.attack_fire: Scorch flames will incinerate your very soul!
tensura.velgrynd.spacetime: Under spacetime collapse, all shall freeze! Taste this dimensional slash!
tensura.velgrynd.cardinal: Maximum acceleration! Cardinal Acceleration — burn it all!
tensura.velgrynd.crescent: Crescent Flame Severance! Cut through everything!
tensura.velgrynd.parallel: Fighting me with numbers? Before a True Dragon, there is only 1 on 1! Parallel Existence!
tensura.velgrynd.penetration: Divine Armor? Before the Scorch Dragon's flame, all defense is but an illusion!
tensura.velgrynd.barrier_hit: Hmph! Such a puny strike cannot even scratch my dragon scales!
tensura.velgrynd.barrier_break: You... dared shatter one layer of my dragon barrier?! Prepare to pay with your life!
tensura.velgrynd.dragon_nova_hit: This destructive energy... Rimuru and Milim's Dragon Nova?! Impossible... aaaaa!
tensura.velgrynd.defeat: Mortal... you have proven your strength. Take my Reverse Scale!
tensura.velgrynd.allied_summon: Very well. In honor of the dragon oath, I shall burn this filth away for you!
tensura.velgrynd.allied_complete: All threats eradicated. If you ever need my aid again, defeat me once more!
tensura.velgrynd.stats_boss: Curious about the power of a True Dragon? This 74M EP is more than enough to crush you!
tensura.velgrynd.stats_allied: Rest assured. Under the protection of the Scorch Dragon, none shall harm you!
tensura.demon.rouge.summon: Oh? Who possesses the caliber to summon Rouge? Do not disappoint me!
tensura.demon.rouge.velgrynd_banter: Velgrynd! Long time no see, let's see how sharp your dragon claws are!
tensura.demon.rouge.domain: Drown in the crimson flame of the Strongest Demon Lord! World-Ending Inferno!
tensura.demon.noir.summon: Kufufufu... What an immense honor for you to be served by Noir!
tensura.demon.noir.combat: Daring to disrespect my Master? Your soul shall feed my claws!
tensura.demon.noir.skill: Kufufu... Disintegrate in absolute despair! Spiritual Collapse!
tensura.demon.blanc.summon: Primordial White Testarossa... Pleased to make your acquaintance. I hope you won't bore me.
tensura.demon.blanc.skill: Bloom, flower of white death! Death Blessing!
tensura.demon.jaune.summon: Haha! Finally, time for some chaos! Primordial Yellow Carrera enters the fray!
tensura.demon.jaune.skill: This Golden Gun will blow away mountains! Eat lead! Golden Abyss Annihilation!
tensura.demon.violet.summon: Ahaha~ Cute little Primordial Violet Ultima is here! Who wants to play with me?
tensura.demon.violet.skill: You're not being well-behaved at all, let me tear you to shreds~! Black Fire Burst!
tensura.demon.bleu.summon: Primordial Blue Rain... How troublesome, let's finish quickly so I can paint.
tensura.demon.bleu.skill: Frigid ice and frost... freeze in eternity.
tensura.demon.vert.summon: Primordial Green Misery... Following orders, I shall cleanse this battlefield.
tensura.demon.vert.skill: Green tragedy... let all end in absolute silence.
dialogue.weapons.milim.summon_greeting: Wahahaha! I am Demon Lord Milim Nava! Who dare summon me with the ancient contract? Did you bring me delicious food?!
dialogue.weapons.milim.cast_dragon_nova: Dragon Nova... Spiritrons converge! Do you dare stand before me?!
dialogue.weapons.milim.interrupted_one: Hmph! That skill hit wasn't bad, but one is far from enough to stop me!
dialogue.weapons.milim.interrupted_reset: Aaaaa! How dare you disrupt my channeling! Fine, I'll start all over again!
dialogue.weapons.milim.fire_dragon_nova_: Dragon Nova!! Purest energy, cleanse everything!
Maximum Output Drago-Nova!! Turn this entire world into ashes!!
dialogue.weapons.milim.cast_horizontal_b: Take this! Horizontal Sacred Light Cannon!!
dialogue.weapons.milim.enraged: You've truly made me angry now! I won't hold back anymore!!
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_noir: Kufufu... Is that you, Noir? Still playing butler serving others as usual?
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_rouge: Huh, Guy?! Did you ditch your Demon Lord duties to run around playing with me?
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_blanc: Oh, Testarossa! That dangerous aristocratic demeanor hasn't changed a bit!
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_jaune: Carrera! Don't bring out nuclear magic the moment you see me!
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_violet: Ultima! That mischievous grin... did you bring any snacks for me?
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_bleu: Rain! Finished your painting yet, or just slacking around here?
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_vert: Misery! Always busy cleaning up Guy's endless messes, huh?
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_demon_lord: Whoa! That aura... You've awakened as a True Demon Lord? Let's spar right now!
dialogue.weapons.milim.greet_human: Tiny human, I am Demon Lord Milim Nava! Don't get on my bad side!
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_noir: Long time no see, Noir. Still utterly loyal and as terrifying as ever.
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_rouge: Primordial Red Guy Crimson... Your presence here heralds great trouble.
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_blanc: Primordial White Testarossa, your elegant presence graces this land.
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_jaune: Carrera! Please refrain from firing nuclear artillery on a whim!
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_violet: Ultima, who is about to fall victim to your innocent smile this time?
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_bleu: Rain... As lethargic and disinterested as always, I see.
dialogue.weapons.demon.greet_vert: Misery, thank you for always quietly tidying up the world's wreckage.
